messages:
alyssa: Rollout done for v1.12 -> prod-slice-a. Canaries passed basic checks, moving to live traffic. Starting mini smoke + livetrace sweep now. Anyone on watch? 

devin: I'm on it. Running quick health + latency checks. 

samir: pulling up dashboards — p95 looks stable so far. No obvious errors in logs. 

maria: I'll do KV cache priming and prefix warmup in the next 5. Ping if you need me to hold traffic. 

jordan: running the curl endpoints, sanity endpoints: 
```bash
curl -sS https://api-prod.redwood.example/health | jq .status
curl -sS https://api-prod.redwood.example/v1/models | jq .count
``` 

deploy-bot: Deploy v1.12 to prod-slice-a completed at 2026-03-17T15:04:36Z :white_check_mark:

alyssa: @devin quick check on error budget and 5xx spike? 

devin: Error budget ok; 5xx spike +0.2% in the last minute, correlated to a single upstream timeout. Retries are fine. Rolling avg latency +30ms but within SLO. 

samir: I see one hotspot on cross-region calls — tracing shows a retry loop for request id trace-6a3f. Raising a tiny fix to reduce client-side retries. 

maria: priming done. KV hit rate up from 14% -> 87% on first prefix set. Should reduce token generation tail latency. 

jordan: smoke script: `scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --slice prod-slice-a --sample 100` ran, 98/100 success, two failures are 504 from the upstream — correlated with that retry loop. 

alyssa: OK good. Plan: merge hotfix to suppress aggressive retries (samir), redeploy patch to slice A canary, rerun smoke in 10m, rollback plan ready if failure >5% or p95 >2x baseline. @samir you good to ship? 

samir: onboarded. I'll push the patch in 6m and tag you. 

devin: I'll keep watch on alerts and can trigger rollback. I set a manual override ready in the console. :thumbsup: 

alyssa: Thanks team — marking thread resolved unless new issues crop up. Leave any follow-ups here. :white_check_mark:
